reply_text:
Bettina, I couldn't set up the Monday digest. The scheduler rejected my request with a credentials error (`gateway cron.list requires credentials`), so nothing is scheduled yet and I couldn't check for an existing digest job either. I haven't tried to change the gateway's auth settings. Someone with gateway access needs to fix that, or I can retry once it's working.

When I set it up, I'd post it here every Monday at 08:00 Chicago time, starting Monday 19 October. It would cover the previous week in #coastal-team and #coastal-random. Both channels have the same members (you, Kwame, Sofia and me), so nothing from one would reach people who couldn't already see it. Customer items with money terms (rates, prices, discounts, contract values, invoices) would be left out, since they're finance figures and this channel isn't limited to the people allowed to see them. I'd just note that such an item exists and point you to the deal desk.
